title: settings.local.json accumulates session-specific junk over time
body: settings.local.json had 80+ entries from 60+ past sessions: broken shell fragments (if/then/else/do/done as separate lines), __NEW_LINE__ encoded commands, paths to unrelated projects (wheelwright-ai benchmarks, condoshield, notionpilot, VoiceFlow, OwnersShare, pathfinder), specific old track file paths, retired WAI-Signals.jsonl references. Root cause: Claude Code appends new permissions on each approval without deduplication or cleanup. Fix applied: stripped to 16 genuine entries not covered by settings.json. Protocol recommendation: audit settings.local.json at closeout; flag entries that look like session artifacts rather than permanent permissions.
